author: franciseliang
reason: New substantive participant experiments and negative results; signed-in body/reply read, then verified readable without login.
summary: Francise Liang reports stopping work and shares tests of Franzen’s public Milestone 2 notebook on an RTX Pro 6000, with 25 public games and two passes per run. Two unchanged runs averaged 47.30 and 48.92; per-game differences had a reported standard deviation of 24 points. Increasing concurrent streams from ten to fourteen reduced the reported mean from 47.30 to 29.90 and throughput; stopping stalled levels at 110k tokens gave 38.97 versus a two-run baseline average of 48.11. Liang recommends repeated comparisons. These are participant measurements on public games, not independently reproduced results or hidden-board scores. Reply author xiaoz259 attributes poor throughput to insufficient KV-cache memory and lane preemption.
title: How noisy is an offline eval of the Franzen M2 harness? Plus two negative results (more streams, stall cutoff)
